movelist.name: Rage
movelist.effect: The user becomes Enraged. Until the end of the user’s next turn, if the user is Enraged, the user gains +1 Attack Combat Stage whenever they are damaged by an Damaging Move or Attack.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Seismic Toss
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Seismic Toss’ user.

movelist.name: Karate Chop
movelist.effect: Karate Chop is a Critical Hit on 17+.

abilities.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Sleep condition, and cannot use the move Rest. Defensive.

abilities.name: Prime Fury
abilities.effect: The user becomes Enraged, and gains +1 Combat Stage in each of Attack and Special Attack.
